2. A5's isolation_verdict has model_fallback_basis 'UNKNOWN', yet inference_only.disables_model_fallback must be literally true (inference_policy.py:130-132). The builder therefore needs an explicit rule: under 3B the basis is the identity policy plus the reroute scan plus a passing replay. Without this rule Gemini is always held.

6. Per-file line endings: the repo is LF while r4 is CRLF for coding.py, controller_guard.py and failures.py; most other files are mixed; agy_protocol.py is pure LF. The r4 freeze rule (freeze-stopped-runtime-r4-source.py:57-63) refuses a convention change and mixed line endings. Each r5 file must be committed in r4's convention, normalised to pure.
7. A5 evidences only the 'gemini-3.8-flash-high' slug. The effort-null binding needs an extra A5 run for the owner's slug, otherwise it binds the -high slug. The pro tier (7-9) stays unbound.
